evidence.title: Show HN: I used Claude Code to address the HN comments on my 2019 game
evidence.excerpt:
In 2019 I posted Aim and Shoot here, a browser shooter where every enemy is a neural network evolved by a genetic algorithm between rounds: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=21353123 The thread had a lot of good feedback that I never got around to.
[…]
This year I gave Claude Code the thread and the repo and worked through it: - "Give the player full health every round" (four of you asked): done.
[…]
- "I wish there was a scoreboard, I wanted a screenshot of how far I got": the game-over screen now shows the round you reached and your best.
[…]
- "The gun sound is jarring": quieter, and M mutes it.
[…]
It's PHP + SQLite on a small VPS, with a local fallback if the server is down.
